comments.author: technion
comments.textRawHtml:
There is a lot of cynicism in this thread but the fact this is still open and hour later ends the narrative in my view. There are not "thousands of swarms of agents autonomously compromising every site for its authors" or any the other x / LinkedIn dribble ive been reading.

It clearly isnt happening.
comments.textZhHtml:

children.author: huhtenberg
children.textRawHtml:
I reconfigured nginx on one of my servers to log all attempted multipart POST requests. Been tailing the log, and while there is a trickle of entries, they all are for empty forms, none are php2shell specific.

Interestingly enough, virtually all of these come from the Google Cloud IP space. There was a single hit from China and two from Europe.
children.textZhHtml:
我在一台服务器上重新配置了 nginx，以记录所有尝试的多部分 POST 请求。一直在跟踪日志，虽然有一些条目，但它们都是空表单，没有一个特定于 php2shell。

有趣的是，几乎所有这些都来自 Google Cloud IP 空间。其中一则来自中国，两则来自欧洲。
